# Derry Lane Towns
> Derry Lane Towns is a pre-construction townhome community by Ballymore Homes at 376 & 390 Derry
> Road West, Mississauga, Ontario. Status: Coming Soon / Registration Open.

## Key Facts
- Builder: Ballymore Homes (Ballymore (Uptown Meadowvale) Corp.)
- Location: 376 & 390 Derry Road West, Mississauga, ON L5W 1N6 — Meadowvale Village
- Home types: Back-to-back, street, and rear-lane townhomes; 2 semi-detached; 2 detached
- Total homes: 120 townhomes + 4 single-family homes
- Sizes: 2-4 bedrooms, up to 3 bathrooms, up to ~2,000+ sq ft
- Starting prices: Townhomes from the high $700,000s; semi-detached from $1 million; detached from $1.2 million
- Deposit: To be announced
- Occupancy: To be announced
- Status: Coming Soon — Registration Open; City of Mississauga rezoning application OZ/OPA 24-2 W11 under review
- Last updated: 2026-10-11

## Common Questions
Q: What is Derry Lane Towns?
A: Derry Lane Towns is a pre-construction townhome community by Ballymore Homes at 376 and 390 Derry Road West in Mississauga's Meadowvale Village. Ballymore Homes is an Ontario builder founded in 1995 and based in Richmond Hill. The plan includes 120 three-storey townhomes — back-to-back, street, and rear-lane styles — plus two semi-detached and two detached homes.
Q: How much do homes at Derry Lane Towns cost?
A: Townhomes at Derry Lane Towns — back-to-back, street towns, and rear-lane towns — are priced from the high $700,000s. Semi-detached homes are priced from $1 million, and detached homes are priced from $1.2 million. These are starting prices and are subject to change. A unit-by-unit price list has not been released.
Q: Where is Derry Lane Towns located?
A: Derry Lane Towns sits at 376 and 390 Derry Road West in Mississauga, on the south side of Derry Road West just west of Hurontario Street. The site is in the historic Meadowvale Village area, Ontario's first Heritage Conservation District, about 7 minutes from Highway 401 and 13 minutes from Meadowvale GO Station.
Q: What home types are available at Derry Lane Towns?
A: Derry Lane Towns will offer back-to-back, street, and rear-lane townhomes, plus semi-detached and detached homes. The city application describes 120 three-storey townhomes, two semi-detached homes, and two detached homes, planned from 2 to 4 bedrooms, up to 3 bathrooms, and up to roughly 2,000+ square feet. Townhomes are priced from the high $700,000s, semi-detached homes from $1 million, and detached homes from $1.2 million.
Q: When is Derry Lane Towns launching?
A: Derry Lane Towns is currently in pre-launch, listed as "Coming Soon" on Ballymore Homes' own site as of October 2026. A City of Mississauga rezoning application for the site (OZ/OPA 24-2 W11) remains under review, and no official VIP launch date has been announced.
Q: What is the deposit structure for Derry Lane Towns?
A: Ballymore Homes has not yet published a deposit structure for Derry Lane Towns. Pre-construction townhomes in Mississauga typically use a staged deposit schedule paid over the first 12 to 18 months after signing, but the exact amounts and dates for this community will be confirmed when the builder opens VIP registration.
Q: What schools serve Derry Lane Towns?
A: Families near Derry Lane Towns have access to Le Flambeau Elementary School, Meadowvale Village Public School, St. Veronica Elementary School, and David Leeder Middle School, all under a 10-minute drive. Sheridan College's Davis Campus and the University of Toronto Mississauga are also within driving distance for post-secondary education.
Q: How do I get VIP access to Derry Lane Towns?
A: VIP access to Derry Lane Towns is granted by registering through the project's official registration form with a name, email, and phone number. Registered buyers are typically notified first when floor plans, pricing, and incentives are released, ahead of the project's general public launch.
Q: Is Derry Lane Towns a good investment?
A: Whether Derry Lane Towns is a good investment depends on an individual buyer's goals, financing, and timeline, and this site does not provide financial advice. Relevant factors include townhomes from the high $700,000s, semi-detached homes from $1 million, and detached homes from $1.2 million, plus its Meadowvale Village location near Highway 401 and GO transit, and its still-unconfirmed occupancy and deposit terms.
Q: How does Derry Lane Towns compare to Applewood Towns?
A: Derry Lane Towns townhomes start from the high $700,000s, in line with Applewood Towns, also priced from the $700s at Dixie Road and Burnhamthorpe Road East. Derry Lane Towns also includes semi-detached homes from $1 million and detached homes from $1.2 million. It sits in the lower-density, heritage-designated Meadowvale Village, while Applewood Towns is closer to Mississauga's denser eastern retail corridor near Dixie Outlet Mall and Sherway Gardens.
